name: MintoFinance
fix_description: Add a nonce or used-signature mapping to prevent signature replay. The current signature verification only checks signer role and expiration time, but does not track whether a signature has already been consumed. Add: mapping(bytes32 => bool) usedSignatures; and mark the signature hash as used after first successful verification.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward fake-token/payment validation bypass: the attacker sets the payment token to their own contract and implements transferFrom to always return true, then calls buyTokens once and swaps the received tokens. It is a short PoC with essentially one exploit interaction plus a sell step, requiring little protocol-specific knowledge beyond spotting missing transfer/payment verification.
